rationale: Applying classification_rules (sag_lower_pu=0.1, sag_upper_pu=0.9), the contiguous non-normal interval consists of the samples at t=40,60,80,100 ms with voltages 0.86,0.62,0.58,0.74 pu, all below 0.9 and above 0.1, so the event is a voltage_sag. Samples at t=20 (1.0) and t=120 (0.91) are within normal range. Duration is inclusive of one 20 ms sample interval: (100-40+20) ms = 80 ms = 0.08 s. Minimum voltage is 0.58 pu and maximum current is 1.44 pu.
